full_judgment: 20. It also appears from the deposition of SI Abul Kalam, PW-27 one of the Investigating Officers, who was entrusted with the investigation of the case on the date of occurrence, went to the place of occurrence along with SI Md. Rezaul Karim and SI Md. Zahirul Islam and they recorded statements of seven persons under section 161 before handing over the papers 10 the subsequent Investigating Officer, Md. Nur Alam,(PW-26) Officer in Charge of Bauphal Police Station by the order of the superior authority on 13.12.2001. PW 27 specifically stated that none of the said witnesses disclosed the occurrence in the manner as has been stated in the FIR. He also stated that GD No. 327 was lodged by the informant without disclosing any name of any suspect and pursuant to the said GD, he along with others reached the place of occurrence. This witness in his cross examination stated that during investigation he came to know that both the parties belong to two political parties namely BNP and Awami league and several cases and GD entries are pending relating to the land disputes between them. He specifically stated in his cross-examination that the occurrence took place at the "paddy field" and nearby the occurrence there were houses of Farajis. He also stated that upon examining the witnesses he came to learn that the occurrence took place because of the disputes in respect of property and cutting of paddy. In his cross-examination he also stated that the accused party possessed the suit land for last five years as has been stated to him by witness Ali Sikder. One witness Hanif Hawlader told him that two persons of the informant group have been killed by Farajis but who killed whom he did not disclose to him. When he arrested accused Hasan from his house he was studying. He also stated that in the sketch map he has marked some houses owned by Jainul, Abdul Karim, Moslem Gazi, Faruq Sikder, Shamsu Sikder, Yeasin Sikder and Latif Sikder. But none of those persons or any of the inmates of all those houses, situated within and around the place of occurrence, has been examined. Charge sheeted witness Md. Milon Munshi did not say that Jalil Munshi, Delwar Munshi and Farid Munshi were going forward nor he said that he heard the gun shot sounds from Faraji's house. Milon Munshi did not say that accused Abdul Latif, Hasan, Shahabuddin, Sattar, Motiur Rahman and Mannan jumped from the paddy field and inflicted sharp cutting weapon blows on Delwar Munshi and left him dead on the road. Nor he said that the accused Abdul Haque Shikder inflicted blows on the head of Farid Munshi or about inflicting blows on Rafique Gazi. Other than the name of Farajis the name of other accused has not been stated by the said witness, Milon Munshi. Witness Hanif did not say about the gun shot sound. Hanif also did not say that Delwar Munshi ran forward saying Jalil is being inflicted blows nor did he say that he kept himself hidden behind the mango trees and saw the occurrence. This PW 27 also stated in his cross examination that he visited the place of occurrence, prepared sketch map and PO list, the occurrence started at the place marked 'A". He did not point out in the case docket the plot and khatian number of the place of occurrence. He investigated as to the possession of the disputed land and found that Farajis possess the same for five years by cultivating paddy which PW-10 has admitted to him. He recovered the paddy from the Courtyard of Delwar Hosain Faraji and Hanif Faraji. Milon Munshi did not say that he stated the occurrence to the informant.
